fact: On 26 April 2025 Gadarif State's tax office launched the Eissaly electronic collection and payment programme as the fourth state in Sudan; the Federal Accounts Chamber's director of electronic collection said it collects state and federal resources and was built by Sudanese hands without outside intervention.
title: ضرائب القضارف تدشن برنامج التحصيل والدفع الالكتروني ايصالي
